# cJSON snapshot

This directory contains an unmodified, SHA-pinned snapshot of
[cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON) used as a fixture for
`@reponova/lang-c` integration tests.

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON
- **Tag**: `v1.7.18`
- **Commit**: `acc76239bee01d8e9c858ae2cab296704e52d916`
- **License**: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

Files included:

- `cJSON.c`, `cJSON.h` — core JSON parser/serializer
- `cJSON_Utils.c`, `cJSON_Utils.h` — JSON Pointer / JSON Patch helpers
- `LICENSE` — MIT license text (copied verbatim from upstream)
- `README.md` — upstream readme (copied verbatim from upstream)

Only the files listed above are vendored; no source modifications have
been made.
